sources.title: Shar's Umbrae
markers: | summary = '''Shar's Umbrae''' is a passive feature that helps the wearer stay undetected.

sources.title: Shar's Aegis
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to surround themselves with {{deity|Shar|Shar's}} protection and gain a bonus to their [[Armour Class]], reduce incoming damage and apply {{Damage type|Necrotic}} damage to all attackers.{{see bugs}}

summary: Medium armour with base AC 16, advantage on Constitution saves and Shar’s Aegis.

fields.Armour Class: Medium Armour. Base AC 16 plus Dexterity modifier up to +2.
fields.Shar’s Umbrae: Gain advantage on Stealth checks while obscured. The armour also grants advantage on Constitution saves.
fields.Shar’s Aegis: Bonus Action on yourself once per Long Rest. Concentrate until Long Rest or until you unequip the armour. Gain +2 AC and Sharran Retribution.
fields.Reported behavior: The rare version also reduces damage through Sharran Retribution when self-cast, but lacks the damaging retaliation.
fields.Base value: 1450 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
